name: Engram-style 50K bigram factored (NGRAM_FACTOR_RANK) + int5 n-gram table + int6 proj
blurb: Hashed N-gram memory (Cheng et al. arXiv:2601.07372 motivated). Low-rank VxR * RxD table when V*D>=2M unless NGRAM_FACTOR_RANK=0. int5 on n-gram table rows, int6 on proj/embed_up, int5 MLP / int6 attn, zstd-22. Same backbone recipe as SOTA family (SmearGate, U-Net skips, GQA, SWA). Replace nulls with measured val_loss/val_bpb/bytes after 8xH100 verification.
